subject.title: fix(browser): keep tab reachability retry delay abortable

question: Should this PR require a managed-browser tab-mutation cancellation trace, or is the supplied production-route real-timer output with mocked reachability sufficient for this narrowly scoped delay change?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not a concrete patch defect: it is whether the repository’s external-PR real-behavior gate permits this route-level mock boundary for a cancellation-latency fix.

options.title: Require managed-browser proof
options.body: Obtain redacted output or a recording of an actual managed tab close, focus, or select action aborted during the retry delay, including elapsed time and no post-abort mutation.

options.title: Accept route-level proof
options.body: Explicitly treat the real-timer production-route output as sufficient because the only mocked boundary is CDP reachability and the patch changes only the intervening delay.

recommendation.title: Require managed-browser proof
recommendation.body: Obtain redacted output or a recording of an actual managed tab close, focus, or select action aborted during the retry delay, including elapsed time and no post-abort mutation.

likelyOwner.reason: They were directly asked to decide proof sufficiency and are the strongest available decision-routing candidate in the supplied context.
